panel.title: Claude Conductor
panel.subtitle: Your Claude Code sessions, live
panel.emptyHint: Run "claude" in a repo — the session will show up here.
panel.hooksWarn: Hooks not installed: the "waiting" state may be approximate. Settings → Hooks.

launcher.focusDesc: Jump to a Claude Code session

settings.notifyOnWaitingDesc: Toast + desktop notification as soon as a session needs you (permission or idle).
settings.notifyOnDoneDesc: Notification when a session ends its turn after working for a while.
settings.doneMinSecondsDesc: Only notify completion if the agent worked at least this many seconds
settings.enrichOnOpenDesc: Reads transcripts (title, branch, model, last message) while the panel is open.
settings.tailLinesDesc: Number of lines shown when opening the Tail
settings.pollIdleDesc: Liveness sweep frequency while the panel is closed (ms)
settings.pollOpenDesc: Sweep + enrichment frequency while the panel is open (ms)
settings.terminalCommandDesc: Terminal used for Resume and opening the transcript (e.g. kitty -e)
settings.hooksDesc: Claude Code hooks push session state to the plugin (zero latency, reliable "waiting" detection). They add no cost: it is just a local IPC call.
settings.hooksNote: Edits ~/.claude/settings.json (a .bak backup is created). Reversible in one click.
